about: The startup dashboard: one page, rebuilt from the repo and GitHub on every merge to main and every hour by the dashboard workflow. Only the founder edits this file (the deploy gate). host: where it is served, for example pm.example.com; empty means it is built but never deployed. cloudflare_pages_project: the Cloudflare Pages project that serves it. The workflow deploys only when a Cloudflare Access application with a login policy covers both the host and <project>.pages.dev, and checks after each deploy that an anonymous visitor gets the login page, not the dashboard. Setup: the handbook, 'The startup dashboard'. documents: the business documents to show; product and technical documents (specs/, docs/) are always added and grouped. portfolio_url: optional; when this venture is on a portfolio, its address (https://...), shown as a link back at the top of the dashboard; portfolio_name: the portfolio's name for that link (default 'Portfolio').
